findings.title: Research verifier candidate import drops the exact research intent binding
findings.classification: implemented-looking incorrect behavior / partial current-authority binding

canonical_requirements.quote: Every consequential grant checks deployment recovery epoch, ScopeEpoch, RoleEpoch when relevant, admitted IntentRevision/PlanRevision, operation identity and applicable WorkspaceGeneration/RuntimeIncarnation.

An in-progress source-only revision remains an unaccepted revision: it does not justify recycling Attempt/writer authority. Exact current-intent proof checks, retained receipts, dependent suspension and prior immutable Plan ceilings remain.

preconditions: Unaccepted investigation_complete intent R1, current independent selected Verifier/current Attempt, active epoch/current generation, no cancellation/pause/unknown effects, capacity and unexpired Episode.

A real current candidate exists in ArtifactService, submitted by the Worker with same legacy spec/current generation and valid policy. Artifact Submit does not restrict typed outcome; no fabricated candidate is required.
Verifier captures R1 input and admits its Episode through the new research admission branch.
Owner admits only a source revision R2; exact source digest changes admitted intent but Attempt/generation/legacy spec/candidate/policy remain unchanged.

trace.effect: Public Submit can leave a real current candidate on a research task; no outcome-type restriction.
Research Episode admits selected independent Verifier with captured R1 research pins, without requiring a production candidate.
Source-only unaccepted R2 updates contract_current but retains task generation and Attempt.
Public Rust create_episode_from_candidate reads current candidate and supplies Some(candidate) to common preparation.
source.is_none() is false, so research_input and current selected research authority checks skipped; research_verification becomes None.
Candidate/spec/generation/policy/current-open checks pass; stale R1 Episode input retained in manifest, research pin absent.
Start checks optional pin only when Some; unchanged generation/open task/current reservation allow fresh stale-input dispatch.

findings.second_ordering: Prepare using candidate under R1, then source-only R2 before start; same None pin bypasses start revalidation.
findings.consequence: Fresh research verification execution can use obsolete admitted input under a different current IntentRevision. The branch tests only the candidate-free route.
findings.test_gap: tests/support/outcome_lifecycle.rs:841–904 invokes create_episode at 873–876; it never invokes create_episode_from_candidate. Existing recorded GREEN cannot establish this path.
findings.confidence: high static source trace; no runtime reproduction permitted or claimed
findings.scope_note: Finding concerns the newly admitted research Episode and its preparation/start binding, not a request to redesign provider/runtime/scope27 or fabricate production evidence.

consumer_audit.name: amend
consumer_audit.assessment: Exact current typed outcome closes either kind; initial legacy mapping inert; accepted amendment fences immediately under global transaction lock. In-progress source-only change does not recycle Attempt.

consumer_audit.name: accept
consumer_audit.assessment: Typed immutable subject binds task/current intent/acceptance/proof/outcome/policy. Research leaves production projections untouched.

consumer_audit.name: fresh grants
consumer_audit.assessment: Current closure/cancellation/admission and exact dependency disposition checked. Superseding prerequisite suspends dependents; explicit exact revalidation required.

consumer_audit.name: grant entry points
consumer_audit.assessment: Fresh grant guards remain. Research candidate-import exception is F1; no claim that shared grant helper fixes every captured-input consumer.

consumer_audit.name: outcome mutation
consumer_audit.assessment: Authentication/generation/scope/current authority precede cache. Terminal policy excludes consequential cached commands; exact accepted receipt exception is scoped by original digest and subject.

consumer_audit.name: artifacts
consumer_audit.assessment: Neutral completion replaces production status; immutable raw bytes remain uploadable. Historical accepted-evidence method requires actual accepted candidate/report; ordinary fresh evidence uses current rules.

consumer_audit.name: mailbox actual targets
consumer_audit.assessment: Actor task and actual delivery/binding/approval targets checked before command cache. Mission messages remain mission operations. Valid Owner-target counterfactual and final positives/refusals inspected.

consumer_audit.name: dispatch
consumer_audit.assessment: Neutral terminal guards preserve cancelled/accepted refusals. F1: optional research pin is absent on candidate-import route, permitting source-only stale-input preparation/start.

consumer_audit.name: cancel/reconcile
consumer_audit.assessment: Legacy CancelAttempt/ReconcileAttempt retain completed refusal; effect-level current Owner cleanup remains distinct.

consumer_audit.name: task wait attention
consumer_audit.assessment: Typed completion wakes bare task waits; recorded satisfaction stays history. Exact dependency grant needs revalidation.

consumer_audit.name: projections
consumer_audit.assessment: Exact current accepted outcome and separate legacy flag/history; fresh eligibility derives open/dependencies rather than raw migration flag.

consumer_audit.name: verification policy
consumer_audit.assessment: Activation is current task-scoped Owner operation and require_open precedes insert.

consumer_audit.name: accepted production replay
consumer_audit.assessment: Only exact authenticated applied acceptance inspects historical intent subject. New key/current proof retains current generation/policy and latest-failed gate. Historical evidence does not grant new production acceptance.

consumer_audit.name: historical Episode retirement
consumer_audit.assessment: Exact broker amendment event task/generation/principal/recovery binding plus expiry, original manifest/result/logs, observed namespace stop, released capacity and unresolved runtime usage checks remain.

consumer_audit.name: credentials/storage
consumer_audit.assessment: Immediate amendment fence and separate assignment increment; unique(task,generation); malformed migration fail-closed; nullable original provenance untouched.

consumer_audit.name: journal/effect observation
consumer_audit.assessment: Existing authorized journal inspection and Stop/log/Release/accounting separate from fresh dispatch. Unknown usage remains reserved; no process-absence inference.

seven_case_matrix.name: negative research full lifecycle
seven_case_matrix.assessment: Two measured generations, independent verifier, source/proof/subject and retained attempts/reservations verified. Candidate-free route succeeds; F1 identifies alternative import route not covered.

seven_case_matrix.name: production parity
seven_case_matrix.assessment: Measured production evidence, original exact receipt after amendment, rekeyed proof refusal, fresh current acceptance and latest-failed controls inspected.

seven_case_matrix.name: initial v1 mapping
seven_case_matrix.assessment: Mapping keeps legacy proof identities, initial mapping does not increment generation; later Owner-only mapping amendment requires fresh work. No accepted v1 evidence was rewritten.

seven_case_matrix.name: source-only and immutable Plan ceilings
seven_case_matrix.assessment: Original Attempt/generation preserved and prior immutable all-caller Plan ceilings checked. Candidate-free stale research input/prepared execution refuse. F1 is missing equivalent validation on candidate import.

seven_case_matrix.name: retirement and uncertain effects
seven_case_matrix.assessment: Before-expiry and unresolved-original-effect refusals, physically stopped/released succession and nullable lead provenance inspected. Not all possible corruptions freshly reproduced; static checks retained.

seven_case_matrix.name: transaction and replay ordering
seven_case_matrix.assessment: Shared pg_advisory_xact_lock serializes contract/admission mutations. Joined HTTP requests observe one permitted serialization; no exhaustive interleaving claim. Payload conflict, idempotency, malformed migration assertions inspected.

seven_case_matrix.name: wait/projection
seven_case_matrix.assessment: Derived exact current projection and research wait wake; historical wait remains satisfied after amendment while exact dependency remains separate.

four_critique_guardrails.name: narrow accepted receipt exception
four_critique_guardrails.assessment: Authentication/scope/generation and full envelope digest precede receipt; consequential cached Worker/Verifier commands refused.

four_critique_guardrails.name: later amendment distinct from dispatch
four_critique_guardrails.assessment: Authorized amendment uses separate eligibility; accepted work cannot dispatch; source-only pin coverage incomplete in F1.

four_critique_guardrails.name: actual Owner targets and raw evidence
four_critique_guardrails.assessment: Actual valid Owner targets tested. RED6 counterfactual removes only target guard; original nonexistent-ID probes not proof. Raw blob storage confers no proof authority.

four_critique_guardrails.name: cleanup/unknown usage/original provenance
four_critique_guardrails.assessment: Legacy cancellation refusal retained. Physical cleanup remains current-authorized; unknown/consumed accounting and original nullable Attempt attribution preserved.
